A malformed data URI with extract_images enabled produces an ImageExtractionFailed warning

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Text<img src="data:BADMIME" alt="broken">end</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(extract_images: true))
puts result.content.inspect
puts result.warnings.inspect
```
